entries.zh: 发迹；发家致富、兴家显达
entries.en: to rise and make one's fortune; to enrich oneself, grow rich

entries.zh: 宽心；宽慰、安心（把心放宽、愁绪舒解）
entries.en: to ease or comfort the heart; to be consoled, set one's mind at ease

entries.zh: 缀连、穿串（把珠子等串连起来）
entries.en: to string, thread (beads); to join, connect
entries.notes: H 栏“輟”与 M 栏音写 Fuār 均难与 ensartar 互证，R 栏 chiē 近“缀（zhuì）”音，疑原字为“缀”之形讹，故降中置信。

entries.en: to string, skewer; to thread together
to string (beads); to thread through, pierce
to string into a strand; to string together in a row
to string cash or coins (chapa = silver coin)
entries.notes: chapa 在马尼拉贸易语境指银币，H 栏“錢”印证此义，不取封存件附注的“牌照”义。

entries.zh: 串连相带；串在一起、相互连属
entries.en: to string (things) joined together; to thread so they hang connected

entries.notes: H 栏“灣”应对音 oan/van，此处对音 ō 更合“澳”（小海湾、泊地），疑 H 栏误识；两字义同为海湾，释义不受影响。

entries.en: to teach, instruct; to show, point out
entries.notes: M 栏含[残]并有 T99 污损、R 栏对音 guiāni 与“教”不合，释义仅据 L+H 两栏，故降低置信。

entries.en: to oversee, supervise; to urge on (in instruction)
to instruct, teach; to admonish, train
to show, point out; to indicate, make known
